name: Obed-edom
bio: Obed-edom was a Gittite into whose house David brought the ark of the covenant after Uzzah's death left him afraid to bring it on into the city of David (2 Samuel 6:9-10). The ark stayed there three months, and the LORD blessed Obed-edom and his entire household because of it; when David heard of the blessing, he took it as his signal that it was safe to bring the ark the rest of the way, and did so with great rejoicing (2 Samuel 6:11-12). When the ark was finally carried on to Jerusalem, Obed-edom himself served among the musicians and as one of the doorkeepers appointed to guard it (1 Chronicles 15:18, 21, 24).
